battle.name: 白馬驛之禍
battle.brief: 唐天祐二年冬，河東節度使李克用追擊幽州節度使劉仁恭失利，退保雁門關外的白馬驛驛站，被燕軍重兵合圍，糧道與退路盡斷。李存孝率五百精騎突出重圍馳援太原，返身再戰，令騎兵下馬持鐵槊步鬥，擊破追騎，燕軍大潰，李克用得返晉陽。此役以驛站為戰場核心，標槍一擊即棄、穿盾即折的投射邏輯，正被唐騎以鐵槊重演。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 白馬驛之禍是唐末河東與幽州兩股藩鎮軍在雁門關外的正面碰撞，交戰雙方都還掛著唐朝的名號。晉方是河東節度使李克用部：節度使衙署設在太原府晉陽，李克用以沙陀、吐渾、達靭等部族的騎兵為骨幹，配河東編戶鄉兵與州縣募兵，牙兵與蕃兵才是真正的突擊力量，編制仍循唐代藩鎮「節度使直轄本部、外州兵屯戍、屯田軍鎮自給」的舊例，不屬於神策、羽林等禁軍系統，也早不聽朝廷調度。燕方是幽州節度使劉仁恭部：劉仁恭原是李克用帳下牙將，895年李克用討幽州時他逃奔薊州，憑幽州軍人推舉自署州事，漢兵與胡騎合編，配營州方向的騎兵與從契丹、室韋交易得來的良馬，衙署設在幽州城，節度使自置牙兵、兼領數州。名義上燕軍仍奉唐詔，實際上已與後梁朱溫通使結盟；朱溫本人沒有在白馬驛露面，但燕軍的追擊正是梁方在河東側翼的協同，目標是在李克用主力被拖在潞州的時候，拔掉其北面的屏蔽。旁觀者有河中王珂、昭義孟方立、魏州王處直、鎮州王鎔等藩鎮；朝廷詔敕照發不誤，卻無一兵一卒可調。此役之後，晉與燕的北線對峙成了唐末最後一段藩鎮邊界。
countriesEn: The Disaster at Baima Post was a collision between two circuit armies of the late Tang, the one from Hedong and the one from Youzhou, fought out beyond Yanmen Pass; both sides still bore the name of the Tang. The Jin side was the army of Li Keyong, military governor of Hedong. His headquarters sat at Jinyang in Taiyuan prefecture, and he built his strength on the cavalry of the Shatuo, Tuyuhun and Daji tribes, backed by the militia of the registered households of Hedong and by the recruited soldiers of the prefectures and counties. The tooth soldiers and the steppe riders were the real striking force, and the organisation still followed the old circuit practice of the Tang, with the military governor holding his own central troops directly, the troops of the outer prefectures garrisoned in the field, and the farming garrisons maintaining themselves. It was not part of the Shence or Yulin guard commands, and it had long stopped taking orders from the court. The Yan side was the army of Liu Rengong, military governor of Youzhou. Liu had been a tooth general in Li Keyong's camp, fled to Jizhou when Keyong attacked Youzhou in 895, and was raised to govern the prefecture by the Youzhou soldiers themselves, with Han troops and steppe riders mixed in the ranks, with the cavalry of the Yingzhou direction and the fine horses traded from the Khitan and the Shiwei. His headquarters was at Youzhou city, and as military governor he held his own tooth soldiers and ruled several prefectures. Nominally the Yan army still obeyed Tang edicts, but in fact it had exchanged envoys and made terms with Zhu Wen of the Later Liang. Zhu Wen himself never appeared at Baima Post, yet the pursuit was the Liang side working on Hedong's northern flank, the object being to remove Hedong's northern screen while Li Keyong's main force was pinned in the south at Luzhou. Bystanders included Wang Ke of Hedong, Meng Fangli of Zhaoyi, Wang Chuzhi of Weizhou and Wang Rong of Zhenzhou; the court went on issuing edicts but had not one soldier to send. After this action the northern line between Jin and Yan became the last border of the late Tang circuit system.
people: 李克用（856至908）字翼聖，出身沙陀部落的朱邪氏，父李國昌為唐綏州騎將，他以平黃巢之亂起家，被朝廷封為晉王，據河東自立，綽號「獨眼龍」「李鴉兒」。白馬驛之圍是他一生最險的一次：主力北伐失利、退路被截、糧秣將盡之際，他作出了最果斷的決定，遣其子李存孝率精騎突圍。李存孝（858至914）本名安敬復，早年為李克用所收的義子，驍勇冠於河東，據舊五代史所記，他曾單騎叩趙州城，迫令成德軍節度使王處直出降；白馬驛之圍既解，李克用收他為養子，賜名李存孝，列於「十三太保」之中，此後數年成為晉軍第一戰將。劉仁恭是對面的主角，原為李克用帳下牙將，因與同列爭寵被貶，895年李克用大舉攻幽州時他逃奔薊州，後殺幽州節度使張文禮自領州事，904年又遣使與朱溫通好，905年乘李克用北伐之際傾力北擊。晉軍內部，存孝與李克用之弟李克寧積不相能，克用自潞州召回存孝、責其驕縱並加鞭責，這道未癒的傷口就壓在白馬驛之役的下面；李存勖、李嗣源等義兄弟此時已能領兵，李嗣源日後接掌河東兵權，成為後唐明宗。燕軍方面，劉仁恭自將精騎追擊突圍而出的存孝至汾水一線，正是這場追擊決定了戰役的收尾。
peopleEn: Li Keyong (856 to 908), courtesy name Yisheng, was born a Shatuo of the Zhuyae clan, his father Li Guochang being a Tang cavalry general at Suizhou. He rose through the suppression of Huang Chao, was made Prince of Jin by the court, set himself up in Hedong, and was known as the One-Eyed Dragon and as Li the Crow. The siege of Baima Post was the most dangerous moment of his life: with his northern expedition beaten, his retreat cut and his grain nearly spent, he made his most decisive decision and sent out his son Li Cunxiao with picked horse to break through. Li Cunxiao (858 to 914) was born An Jingfu, a follower taken into Li Keyong's service in his youth, and the bravest man in Hedong; the Old History of the Five Dynasties records that he once rode alone to the gate of Zhaozhou and forced Wang Chuzhi, military governor of Chengde, to come out and surrender. Once the siege was lifted, Li Keyong took him as a foster son, gave him the name Cunxiao, and set him among the Thirteen Guardians, and for the following years he was the leading warrior of the Jin host. Liu Rengong was the other principal figure. He had been a tooth general in Li Keyong's camp, was demoted after quarrelling with his equals, fled to Jizhou when Keyong marched against Youzhou in 895, later killed Zhang Wenli, the military governor of Youzhou, and took the prefecture for himself; in 904 he sent envoys to make terms with Zhu Wen, and in 905 he threw his whole weight north against a Keyong whose army was away on campaign. Inside the Jin camp the friction between Cunxiao and Li Keying, the prince's younger brother, ran deep; Keyong had recalled Cunxiao from Luzhou, blamed him for his arrogance and had him flogged, and that unhealed wound lay underneath the battle at Baima Post. Li Cunxu and Li Siyuan, his sworn brothers, could already command troops by then, and Li Siyuan would one day take over the military command of Hedong and become the Mingzong of the Later Tang. On the Yan side, Liu Rengong led his picked horse in person against the column that had broken out, down to the Fen river, and that pursuit decided how the engagement ended.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬標槍不會出現在白馬驛：共和國末期到帝國早期的羅馬軍械庫，與唐末的河東軍械庫相隔萬里，905年的塞外沒有任何羅馬式的投槍作戰，它在這場戰役裡的位置是一個技術坐標。羅馬標槍是帝國軍團重裝步兵的制式投射兵器，槍幹中空、外束金屬，捅穿盾牌之後即行折斷，敵兵只能帶著半截槍退回掩體，等於用一次投擲換掉敵人一柄長矛與一面盾牌；羅馬戰術因此是方陣前列密集齊射兩輪標槍，把對方盾牌打成篩子，重裝步兵再提短劍衝鋒，兩翼騎兵以投射兵器干擾敵陣。同一套邏輯在白馬驛以唐制的方式重演：燕軍追騎前突，李存孝反其道而行，令騎兵下馬，以鐵槊步鬥，標槍與鐵槊同屬「一擊即棄」的短程冷兵器，一擊不中便無第二次。河東軍的實際裝備以馬匹為第一等，沙陀騎兵用控弦弓，配環首刀與馬槊，騎兵的貼身近戰靠環首刀，步騎通用的長兵是槊，槍桿木質、刃為鐵，與標槍同屬窄而長的穿刺型，差別在於槊要留給自己再用，故鏤脊、加寬刃身以免折斷；防具是唐代明光鎧與兜鍪，遠射有蹶張弩、臂張弩與單發弩，箭為制式消耗品；營壘與攻城有撞車、飛石、巢車與飛火閣一類猛火油裝備。燕軍則以幽州、營州系的騎兵、良馬與營帳具為主，並從契丹、室韋方向取得弓矢與皮甲。白馬驛本身是唐代驛道上的驛站，驛馬、驛館、儲糧與烽燧才是這場圍困真正的主戰裝備：糧道一斷，驛館存糧見底，存孝的突圍才不得不走二百餘里。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on the card never fought at Baima Post. The arsenals of Rome in the late Republic and early Empire lay thousands of li from the Hedong arsenal of the late Tang, and nothing Roman fought on the frontier north of the pass in 905; the place of the weapon in this battle is that of a technical coordinate. The pilum was the standard missile of the armoured infantry of the Roman legions, hollow in the shaft and bound with metal, and it snapped after passing through a shield, so that the enemy could only carry half a weapon back to his cover; in effect a single throw had cost the enemy a long spear and a shield. Roman tactics were therefore to mass two volleys of pila at the front of the square, riddle the opposing shields, and then send the armoured infantry forward with their short swords while the cavalry on the flanks kept up the missile pressure. The same logic was reproduced at Baima Post in Tang forms: the Yan horse came up in pursuit, and Li Cunxiao did the opposite, ordering his riders to dismount and fight on foot with the iron spear, for the pilum and the iron spear belong to the same family of short-range cold weapons, thrown once and thrown away, useless after a single strike. What the Hedong host actually carried put the horse first: the Shatuo cavalry used the composite bow, the ring-pommel sabre and the long spear, the sabre for the close work of horsemen, and the spear, in its foot and mounted forms, as the universal long arm of both arms. The shaft of the spear was wood with an iron blade, a narrow penetrating form like the pilum, but unlike the pilum the spear had to survive the fight, and so it was socketed and its blade widened and grooved to keep it from breaking. Defensive equipment was the Tang bright armour and helmet; at range there were the pressed crossbow, the drawn crossbow and the single-shot crossbow, with arrows as a standard consumable; for camp and siege work there were battering rams, stone-throwers, siege towers and oil-fire devices of the feihuo type. The Yan army relied on the cavalry, the strong horses and the tent gear of the Youzhou and Yingzhou districts, and drew bows and arrows from the Khitan and the Shiwei. Baima Post itself was a staging station on the Tang courier road, and the post-horses, the station buildings, the stored grain and the beacon towers were the real weapons of this siege: once the supply line was cut and the grain of the station ran down, Cunxiao had no choice but to ride two hundred li and more.
tactics: 燕軍的戰法是截斷與困斃，而不是正面強攻。劉仁恭在李克用北伐失利、隊伍疲憊之際以騎兵邀擊，迫其北走，再以步騎大軍封住雁門關外南北數十里的通道，把晉軍主力合圍於白馬驛一線；他沒有急攻，而是掘長壕以斷絕糧道，圍而不打，把塞外十一月的寒氣、草料不足與糧秣斷絕變成自己的盟友，被圍者的馬匹每日都在吃掉草料，而燕軍可以從南面的燕地就地補給。晉軍退保驛站，利用驛館垣牆結營固守，收攏潰散部隊，等待轉機。轉機來自一支五百人的奇兵：李存孝率精騎夜出重圍，不走大路而循驛道山徑疾行二百餘里，趕到太原，說服留守將吏發兵接應，再率援軍回身迎戰。存孝的處置極其大膽，面對劉仁恭親率的追騎，他下令騎兵全部下馬，以鐵槊步鬥，密集的短兵長槊頂住了騎兵的衝勢，敵騎不能近身，反被斬獲；然後乘勝追奔，直抵晉陽，奪其馬匹輜重，盡取燕軍所掠。局部的戰術反轉改變了整個戰局，被圍者的奇兵與援軍會合於敵後，圍攻者反而成了被追擊的一方。這套以步制騎、以冷兵器近身打散騎兵衝勢的辦法，正是羅馬標槍與短劍組合背後的同一條邏輯。
tacticsEn: The Yan method was interception and strangulation rather than frontal assault. At the moment when Li Keyong's northern expedition had failed and his troops were spent, Liu Rengong struck with his cavalry to drive the Jin north, then closed the passes and the roads for tens of li with a mass of foot and horse, enclosing the main Jin force on the line of Baima Post. He did not hurry to attack; he cut the supply with a long trench and besieged without fighting, turning the cold of the eleventh month beyond the pass, the shortage of fodder and the broken supply line into allies of his own, for the horses of the besieged were eating up their fodder every day, while the Yan army could draw its supplies from the Yan country to the south. The Jin closed in on the post station, used the walls of the station buildings to form a camp, gathered the broken troops and waited for an opening. The opening came with a force of five hundred: Li Cunxiao took picked horse out of the encirclement by night, rode the mountain tracks of the courier road instead of the main road, covered more than two hundred li in a single push, reached Taiyuan, persuaded the officers there to send troops out to meet him, and led the relief back to meet the enemy. His handling of it was extremely bold. Faced with Liu Rengong's own pursuing horse, he ordered every rider to dismount and fight on foot with the iron spear, and the massed short weapons held off the shock of the cavalry, which could not close and was cut down instead; then, riding the victory, he pursued as far as Jinyang and took the enemy's horses and baggage, carrying off everything the Yan army had plundered. A tactical reversal on a small front changed the whole battle: the garrison's strike force and its relief met the enemy in the rear, and the besieger became the pursued. That method of meeting horse with foot, of breaking the shock of cavalry with cold weapons at close quarters, is the same logic that stood behind the pairing of the pilum with the short sword in Rome.
data: 可核對的數字集中在年表、兵力與行程三處。年表是：895年李克用大舉攻幽州，劉仁恭敗走薊州；903年存孝代克用屯潞州，與梁軍相持，潞州之戰打成拉鋸；904年李克用自潞州召還存孝，責其驕縱並加鞭責；905年即天祐二年冬，晉軍北伐失利，李克用退保白馬驛，遭燕軍合圍，存孝突圍馳援得解；次年潞州陷於後梁。兵力上，燕軍追擊部隊以步騎數萬計，舊史又有十萬之說，當屬誇大；李存孝突圍時只帶五百精騎，劉仁恭自將精騎追之，一部記載說存孝以數百騎當追騎數千，比例極懸殊；圍困歷時數十日，一說旬月有餘，與存孝往返奔馳二百餘里的行程相合。損失上，燕軍追騎被擊潰，存孝追奔至晉陽，記載稱斬首萬餘級、獲馬數千匹、輜重盡失，此類數字古書常有誇張，但可確認的一點是，燕軍在北線的野戰精銳一時盡失，短期內無力再追。距離上，白馬驛在雁門關外，緊接太原北面的驛道，驛程約二百餘里，存孝一夜之間跑完大半。日期上，通鑑把此役繫於天祐二年冬，與上述年表相合。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked sit in three places, the chronology, the strengths and the distances. The chronology runs: in 895 Li Keyong marched in force against Youzhou and Liu Rengong was defeated and fled to Jizhou; in 903 Cunxiao took over the garrison at Luzhou for Keyong and stood off against the Liang army in the long war of Luzhou; in 904 Keyong recalled Cunxiao from Luzhou, blamed him for his arrogance and had him flogged; in the winter of 905, the second year of the Tianyou era, the Jin northern expedition was defeated, Li Keyong fell back on Baima Post and was enclosed by the Yan host, and Cunxiao broke out to bring help and lift the siege; the following year Luzhou fell to the Later Liang. On strength, the pursuing Yan force was counted in tens of thousands of foot and horse, and the old histories even speak of a hundred thousand, which is certainly an exaggeration; when Cunxiao broke out he took only five hundred picked riders, and Liu Rengong led his own cavalry after him, one account giving a few hundred against several thousand, a desperately unequal match. The siege lasted some tens of days, said by some to run past a full month, which fits the round trip of more than two hundred li. On losses, the pursuing cavalry was broken and the pursuit carried through to Jinyang; the record gives more than ten thousand heads taken, several thousand horses captured and all the baggage lost. Old books habitually exaggerate such figures, but one thing can be confirmed: the field cavalry of Yan in the north were swept away at one stroke and could not pursue again for a while. On distance, Baima Post lay beyond Yanmen Pass, tight on the courier road north of Taiyuan, some two hundred li from the city, and Cunxiao ran the greater part of it in a single night. On date, the Comprehensive Mirror places this action in the winter of the second year of Tianyou, in agreement with the chronology above.
cause: 打起來的根子有三層。第一層是李克用與劉仁恭的宿怨與地盤之爭：895年李克用討幽州，劉仁恭敗走薊州，此後燕地不肯服晉，兩家在河套一線的草場、馬群與部族控制上糾纏了十年，彼此都清楚對方的營壘與騎兵是什麼成色，所以李克用把主力推向北面的時候，劉仁恭必定傾巢出擊。第二層是後梁朱溫在南方點的火：朱溫以潞州為正面目標，903年起重兵圍困上黨，把李克用的精兵釘在西南，同時遣使遊說燕軍，許以官爵與馬駝之利，讓劉仁恭在北面動手，使晉軍兩面受敵。潞州圍城一拖三年，晉軍的注意力與糧秣大半被吸在西南，這才是白馬驛得以成立的前提。第三層是河東內部的裂痕：存孝驕縱而與克寧爭功，克用召回鞭責，父子兄弟之間的信任受損；劉仁恭正是看準這點，圍而不攻，讓時間替他把河東的內訌放大成降卒的浪潮。引爆點看似偶然，北伐一敗、退路一斷而已，但目標非常明確：劉仁恭要的是讓河東在北方失去屏蔽，甚至在李克用本人崩潰之前逼出新的節度使。
causeEn: There were three layers behind the fighting. The first was the old grudge and the quarrel over land between Li Keyong and Liu Rengong. When Keyong attacked Youzhou in 895 Liu Rengong was defeated and fled to Jizhou, and from then on the Yan country would not submit to Jin; the two had been tangled for a decade over the pastures, the horse herds and the control of the tribes along the frontier, and each knew exactly what the other's camp and horse were made of, so the moment Keyong pushed his main force north, Liu Rengong was certain to come out with everything he had. The second layer was the fire that Zhu Wen of the Later Liang lit from the south. With Luzhou as his target in Henan, he had besieged Shangdang with heavy troops from 903 onward, pinning the best of Keyong's soldiers in the southwest, and at the same time sent envoys to the Yan army, promising office, horses and camels, so that Liu Rengong would strike in the north and the Jin would be squeezed on two sides. The siege of Luzhou dragged on for three years and drew away most of the Jin army's attention and grain, and that, rather than anything else, was the premise that made Baima Post possible. The third layer was the fissure inside Hedong. Cunxiao was arrogant and quarrelled with Keying over credit, Keyong called him back and flogged him, and the trust between father and son and between brothers was broken; Liu Rengong saw exactly this and chose to besiege without attacking, letting time magnify the internal quarrel of Hedong into a flood of surrenders. The trigger looked accidental, a lost battle and a cut road and nothing more, but the purpose was plain: Liu Rengong wanted the northern screen of Hedong removed, and perhaps a new military governor forced out of Li Keyong before the old one broke.
impact: 白馬驛之禍的結果，是河東保住了，而燕地坐大。第一，河東軍隊的元氣大傷。李克用雖脫圍而歸，部眾損失慘重，潞州方向又於次年淪陷，兩翼同時受損；李存勖接位後仍要花十餘年時間才重新壓到河北，正是這次重創的直接後果。第二，李存孝的地位由此確立。他以五百騎破數萬追兵、名震河東，隨後被收為養子，賜名存孝，列名十三太保，成為晉軍的旗幟人物；但同一場戰役也為他種下隱患，功高震主、與同列不睦，914年他終於被李克用下令以車府絞殺，晉軍失去最強的戰將，元氣再損。第三，幽州從此不再受晉軍牽制。劉仁恭坐大燕地，其子劉守光在燕國稱帝，936年引契丹兵南下攻汴，後唐因此覆亡；白馬驛之後北方邊界的一步步後退，最後都通向燕雲十六州落入契丹之手，這條線的起點正是在雁門關外的那幾日。對後世將領而言，此役也是一堂關於死地的課：孤軍陷於塞外、糧道既絕時，最有效的解法不是固守待援，而是以一支精銳奇兵直穿敵後。
impactEn: The result of the Disaster at Baima Post was that Hedong survived while Yan grew strong. First, the Jin army was badly mauled. Li Keyong came out of the siege, but his troops had suffered heavily, Luzhou was lost the following year, and both wings were damaged at once; that Li Cunxu still needed a dozen years after his accession to press back down on Hebei is the direct consequence of this mauling. Second, the standing of Li Cunxiao was settled by it. He broke tens of thousands of pursuers with five hundred riders and became the talk of Hedong, was then taken as a foster son, given the name Cunxiao, and counted among the Thirteen Guardians, the banner figure of the Jin host; yet the same battle planted the seed of his fate, for his great merit alarmed his lord and his quarrels with his equals ran deep, and in 914 Li Keyong had him killed in the cart prison, so that the Jin lost its strongest warrior and was weakened a second time. Third, Youzhou was never restrained by the Jin again. Liu Rengong grew powerful in the Yan country, his son Liu Shouguang proclaimed himself emperor of Yan, and in 936 he called in Khitan troops to march south against Bian and so brought the Later Tang down; the step by step retreat of the northern frontier after Baima Post ran all the way to the fall of the sixteen prefectures of Yanyun into Khitan hands, and that line begins in those few days outside Yanmen Pass. For later commanders the battle was also a lesson in the ground of death: when a lone army is trapped beyond the pass and the supply is already cut, the effective answer is not to sit and wait for relief, but to send a picked force straight through the enemy's rear.
result: 打點完，李克用回到晉陽，白馬驛沒有淪陷。燕軍的合圍被存孝自內部打開：五百精騎夜出重圍，二百餘里疾行至太原，帶回援兵，再以步下馬持鐵槊的近身戰術擊潰劉仁恭親率的追騎，追奔直抵晉陽，燕軍所掠的馬匹輜重盡為晉軍所取。記載稱存孝一戰斬首萬餘級，雖有誇張，燕軍在北線的野戰精銳確實一掃而空，短期內再無力北進，李克用得以保住太原與河東的基本盤。存孝因功被收為養子、賜名李存孝，列於十三太保；然而勝利的代價也立刻記在帳上，主力的損失、潞州方向的失守、以及與養父義兄弟之間日深的裂痕，都在同一個冬天種下。904年召回受責的餘怨、905年白馬驛的殊勳、914年被絞殺的結局，串起來是河東軍團在五代前夜最典型的一條人物曲線。北線的大局並未因這一役而定：燕軍退回幽州，李克用退回太原，雁門關外那條驛道此後仍是兩家的分界線，真正的較量要等到十數年後李存勖以傾國之力掃平河北才見分曉。
resultEn: When it was done, Li Keyong was back at Jinyang and Baima Post had not fallen. The siege was opened from within by Cunxiao: five hundred picked riders went out of the encirclement by night, rode more than two hundred li to Taiyuan, brought back the relief, and then broke Liu Rengong's own pursuing horse by fighting on foot with the iron spear, pursuing as far as Jinyang and taking the horses and baggage the Yan army had plundered. The record gives more than ten thousand heads taken, exaggerated though it is, but the field cavalry of Yan in the north were indeed swept away and could not advance again for a while, so that Li Keyong was able to hold Taiyuan and the base of Hedong. Cunxiao was rewarded for it, taken as a foster son, given the name Cunxiao and counted among the Thirteen Guardians; yet the price of the victory was entered in the ledger at once, for the loss of the main force, the fall of Luzhou, and the deepening cracks between the foster father and the sworn brothers were all sown in that same winter. The grievance of the recall and the flogging of 904, the great exploit of 905 at Baima Post and the strangling of 914 form together the typical curve of a man in the Hedong war-band on the eve of the Five Dynasties. The shape of the north was not settled by this one battle: the Yan army withdrew to Youzhou, Li Keyong withdrew to Taiyuan, and the courier road outside Yanmen Pass remained the boundary between them, the real decision waiting until a dozen years later, when Li Cunxu swept across Hebei with the resources of a state.
